text:
Priya: Published the RCA for the 03/14 serving degradation: https://redwood.internal/rca/2523456789. Short summary — cache key scoping bug + missing fallback test. I'm listing priority action items and owners below. Please ack and flag anything I missed; I'll send calendar invites for follow-ups.

Alex: Thanks Priya. Quick Q — who will own the canary rollback verification?

Priya: Assigned to Simon (eng-oncall). Also Alex will take lead on the cache key fix. Full action list is in the doc but pasted here for visibility.

Simon: I can do the canary verification. ETA EOD tomorrow (3/16) unless we need a longer window.

Priya: Perfect — noted. Pasted action items:

```
1) tighten cache key scope — owner: Alex — due: 2025-03-21
2) add automated fallback test to CI (unit + e2e) — owner: Priya — due: 2025-03-18
3) canary rollback verification + runbook update — owner: Simon — due: 2025-03-16
4) cross-region fallback policy review — owner: Tracy — due: 2025-03-22
5) postmortem publish + external customer note draft — owner: Product — due: 2025-03-17
```

oncall-bot: Created follow-up ticket rca-2523456789-followups and scheduled a checkpoints meeting: 2025-03-17 16:00 UTC. Reminder will post 24h before.

Tracy: Please add me to the verification call if we need cross-region checks. Also can you invite infra-ops so they can brief on the fallback policy?

Priya: Will add infra-ops and product to the invite. Sending calendar invite now. Also adding a short pre-read in the doc (section: "verification checklist").

Alex: :thumbsup:

Simon: A couple of notes from oncall during the incident — I'll attach logs to the ticket and mark any TODOs that need infra access.

Priya: Thanks Simon — appreciate the logs. Final ask: owners, please update the doc with progress by EOD Friday. We'll use the 3/17 checkpoint to confirm closures and decide on customer comms.

Alex: copying SLA/ops for visibility.

Tracy: acked.

Priya: Closing thread — will post the calendar invite link shortly and update the RFC-style checklist in the doc. Thanks everyone.
